title: Speckled
identify: Tiny contrasting dots distributed across the glaze.
recognition: Small dark or coloured spots that do not necessarily form a regular pattern.

confused_with.difference: Oil spot: larger rounded, often metallic spots.
Speckles are coloured marks, not holes; pinholes are tiny openings.
